COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1744 of 2021
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Lalit Samant, Advocate for 
respondent nos. 1 to 4.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
Issue notices to the private 
respondents, by registered post, 
acknowledgment due.
Steps to be taken within one week.
Grievance of the petitioner is that 
despite having been regularized on the 
post of Conductor on 01.05.1989, he has 
been placed below the persons, who were 
appointed on compassionate ground, in 
the year 1990 and 1998. 
Petitioner made a representation 
regarding his seniority, which has been 
rejected. In this writ petition, petitioner 
has challenged the rejection order passed 
by Managing Director, Uttarakhand 
Transport Corporation. 
Learned counsel appearing for  respondent nos. 1 to 4 prays for and is 
granted four weeks’ time for filing counter 
affidavit. Two weeks’ thereafter is 
granted to the petitioner for filing 
rejoinder affidavit.
List this matter after six weeks. 
 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 24.02.2022
Navin
